entries.message: pairs its tabs with panels by order, and has {tabs} tabs but {panels} panels, so some tab controls no panel.
entries.fix: Give each panel data-value matching its tab's value, or write one panel per tab.

entries.message: has no direct child marked slot="tabs", so there are no tabs to wire and every panel stays as written.
entries.fix: Put the tab buttons in one container, such as <div slot="tabs">, as the first child.

entries.message: has a tab that is not a <button>, so Enter and Space do not choose it and a form may submit it.
hides its inactive panels with hidden="until-found", and a page rule gives them display: none (a reset such as [hidden] { display: none }), so find-in-page cannot reach them.
entries.fix: Scope the rule to [hidden]:not([hidden="until-found"]), or set findable="false" to hide the panels from find-in-page on purpose.
